stylePrompt: Create ONE square transparent-background game avatar, a single centered head-and-shoulders chibi portrait. Match the supplied existing avatar's visual style closely: huge expressive glossy eyes where appropriate, large head, small shoulders, crisp detailed anime lineart, polished cel shading, warm cute look. Preserve the requested character's iconic features and individual face. Entire head, ears, accessories and hair fit within the canvas with a small margin; shoulders can end at bottom. Clear at 64px. No frame, labels, lettering, watermark, scenery, other characters, or background. The supplied image is only a STYLE reference. Character:
